lead: The same course, three different ways of getting onto it. Whichever you choose, the place is only yours once the confirmation email arrives.

panels.title: For individuals
panels.bodytext:
Enrol online at any hour, or come to the desk in Marnau between eight and four. You will be asked for your name, address, date of birth and the course number from the programme.

Payment is by transfer within ten days; nobody has to pay at the desk. If the course is already full you go onto the waiting list at once and hear from us within a week — roughly one in five places comes free again before the start.

panels.title: For companies
panels.bodytext:
Companies book by email, with the names of the participants and one billing address. We confirm the group, hold the places for fourteen days and send a single invoice after the course.

From six participants a course can run at your own address, in the morning if that suits the shift better. Travel costs inside the district are included in the day rate.

panels.title: For clubs and parishes
panels.bodytext:
Clubs, parishes and voluntary groups pay the reduced rate, which is a third off every course in the programme. Send us the group, and we will tell you which of the four houses has a free room on your evening.

The reduction applies to the course fee only. Materials, examination fees and the certificate are charged as they are for everybody else.
